2.consolidated_definition: Variedad de ñame. También llamado ñame (de) Guinea. Erróneamente algunos le llaman ñame habanero.
2.en_consolidated_definition: Variety of yam. Also known as Guinea yam. Erroneously referred to by some as Habanero yam.
